units.displayText: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, I'm sorry..."

units.rawText: <color=orange>"Goodbye..."</color>
units.displayText: "Goodbye..."

units.rawText: <color=orange>Don't go.</color>
units.displayText: Don't go.

units.displayText: Greetings, Professor {교수}!

spans.text: Greetings, Professor

units.rawText: I am none other than LabMem No. 001, destroyer of this world's ruling order, the seeker of chaos, the founder of the Lab, the insane mad scientist...
units.displayText: I am none other than LabMem No. 001, destroyer of this world's ruling order, the seeker of chaos, the founder of the Lab, the insane mad scientist...

spans.text: I am none other than LabMem No. 001, destroyer of this world's ruling order, the seeker of chaos, the founder of the Lab, the insane mad scientist...

units.rawText: <size=40>HOUOUIN KYOOOUUUUMA!</size>
units.displayText: HOUOUIN KYOOOUUUUMA!

spans.text: HOUOUIN KYOOOUUUUMA!

units.rawText: ...I'm actually starting to feel second-hand embarrassment here.
units.displayText: ...I'm actually starting to feel second-hand embarrassment here.

spans.text: ...I'm actually starting to feel second-hand embarrassment here.

units.rawText: ...Hououin Kyouma? A mad scientist?
units.displayText: ...Hououin Kyouma? A mad scientist?

spans.text: ...Hououin Kyouma? A mad scientist?

units.rawText: Indeed! That would be none other than yours truly... Hey, wait a minute, what, I say what are you trying to do, you pink-haired catgirl?!
units.displayText: Indeed! That would be none other than yours truly... Hey, wait a minute, what, I say what are you trying to do, you pink-haired catgirl?!

spans.text: Indeed! That would be none other than yours truly... Hey, wait a minute, what, I say what are you trying to do, you pink-haired catgirl?!

units.rawText: Security, this is Persicaria, we have a dangerous person here who needs to be taken into custody.
units.displayText: Security, this is Persicaria, we have a dangerous person here who needs to be taken into custody.

spans.text: Security, this is Persicaria, we have a dangerous person here who needs to be taken into custody.

units.rawText: Wait a minute! It's not what you think!
units.displayText: Wait a minute! It's not what you think!

spans.text: Wait a minute! It's not what you think!

units.rawText: Ah, that's right! Actually, we're carrying out Operation Víðarr!
units.displayText: Ah, that's right! Actually, we're carrying out Operation Víðarr!

spans.text: Ah, that's right! Actually, we're carrying out Operation Víðarr!

units.rawText: ...Operation Víðarr?
units.displayText: ...Operation Víðarr?

spans.text: ...Operation Víðarr?

units.rawText: Correct! This operation involves the destinies of all mankind!
units.displayText: Correct! This operation involves the destinies of all mankind!

spans.text: Correct! This operation involves the destinies of all mankind!

units.rawText: If you don't hang up, I'll send the order to my subordinates and have them detonate hidden explosives to cause havoc.
units.displayText: If you don't hang up, I'll send the order to my subordinates and have them detonate hidden explosives to cause havoc.

spans.text: If you don't hang up, I'll send the order to my subordinates and have them detonate hidden explosives to cause havoc.

units.rawText: How about that? If you're scared, then end your call right...
units.displayText: How about that? If you're scared, then end your call right...

spans.text: How about
that
? If you're scared, then end your call right...

units.rawText: Croque, bring the heavy weapons over right now. Also, have Chelsea and Zion begin sweeping the Oasis' structures, there might be an upcoming wave of explosions that needs to be dealt with.
units.displayText: Croque, bring the heavy weapons over right now. Also, have Chelsea and Zion begin sweeping the Oasis' structures, there might be an upcoming wave of explosions that needs to be dealt with.

units.rawText: What...!
units.displayText: What...!

spans.text: What...!

units.rawText: Please wait! That's not our intention! Please don't take what Okabe says too seriously!
units.displayText: Please wait! That's not our intention! Please don't take what Okabe says too seriously!

spans.text: Please wait! That's not our intention! Please don't take what Okabe says too seriously!

units.rawText: All that was just his chuuni ravings! They're just his delusions; they're not actually true!
units.displayText: All that was just his chuuni ravings! They're just his delusions; they're not actually true!

spans.text: All that was just his chuuni ravings! They're just his delusions; they're not actually true!

units.rawText: Muuuu?!
units.displayText: Muuuu?!

spans.text: Muuuu?!

units.rawText: ...Chuuni ravings? Delusions? If he is truly that badly afflicted, the Oasis can provide him with treatment.
units.displayText: ...Chuuni ravings? Delusions? If he is truly that badly afflicted, the Oasis can provide him with treatment.

spans.text: ...Chuuni ravings? Delusions? If he is truly that badly afflicted, the Oasis can provide him with treatment.

units.rawText: The mood in the air instantly turns awkward.
units.displayText: The mood in the air instantly turns awkward.

spans.text: The mood in the air instantly turns awkward.

units.rawText: Er... Actually, er...
units.displayText: Er... Actually, er...

spans.text: Er... Actually, er...

units.rawText: I think his case is terminal, there's no curing him...
units.displayText: I think his case is terminal, there's no curing him...

spans.text: I think his case is terminal, there's no curing him...

units.rawText: Hey!
units.displayText: Hey!

spans.text: Hey!

units.rawText: I see, so this condition called "chuuni" is a severe disease... Looks like we need to pay even closer attention to it. I'll contact the Medical Department...
units.displayText: I see, so this condition called "chuuni" is a severe disease... Looks like we need to pay even closer attention to it. I'll contact the Medical Department...

spans.text: I see, so this condition called "chuuni" is a severe disease... Looks like we need to pay even closer attention to it. I'll contact the Medical Department...

units.rawText: There's no need for that, Persicaria. Let me handle this.
units.displayText: There's no need for that, Persicaria. Let me handle this.

spans.text: There's no need for that, Persicaria. Let me handle this.

units.rawText: Professor? Do you know how to treat this illness?
units.displayText: Professor? Do you know how to treat this illness?

spans.text: Professor? Do you know how to treat this illness?

units.rawText: Ahem, I once knew a, er, friend, yes, a friend with this problem... In any case, don't worry about it, Persicaria. You should go deal with the issues caused by their appearance.
units.displayText: Ahem, I once knew a, er, friend, yes, a friend with this problem... In any case, don't worry about it, Persicaria. You should go deal with the issues caused by their appearance.

spans.text: Ahem, I once knew a, er, friend, yes, a friend with this problem... In any case, don't worry about it, Persicaria. You should go deal with the issues caused by their appearance.

units.rawText: I'm certain that Mr. Okabe and Miss Kurisu are alright, so leave this place to me.
units.displayText: I'm certain that Mr. Okabe and Miss Kurisu are alright, so leave this place to me.

spans.text: I'm certain that Mr. Okabe and Miss Kurisu are alright, so leave this place to me.

units.rawText: ...Alright, but please take care of yourself.
units.displayText: ...Alright, but please take care of yourself.

spans.text: ...Alright, but please take care of yourself.

units.rawText: The pink-haired catgirl seems to be dubious about all this, but she eventually departs as asked, leaving the Professor, Kurisu and myself in the lab.
units.displayText: The pink-haired catgirl seems to be dubious about all this, but she eventually departs as asked, leaving the Professor, Kurisu and myself in the lab.

spans.text: The pink-haired catgirl seems to be dubious about all this, but she eventually departs as asked, leaving the Professor, Kurisu and myself in the lab.

units.rawText: After seeing the Professor facepalming, it hits me—now is the time for a mad scientist to strike!
units.displayText: After seeing the Professor facepalming, it hits me—now is the time for a mad scientist to strike!

spans.text: After seeing the Professor facepalming, it hits me—now is the time for a mad scientist to strike!

units.rawText: O Professor <cmdr> of the Oasis, thank you for hiding my true identity from Catgirl-san, who was unaware of the truth. That being the case, you must understand the weighty burden that I must bear.
units.displayText: O Professor {교수} of the Oasis, thank you for hiding my true identity from Catgirl-san, who was unaware of the truth. That being the case, you must understand the weighty burden that I must bear.

spans.text: O Professor
of the Oasis, thank you for hiding my true identity from Catgirl-san, who was unaware of the truth. That being the case, you must understand the weighty burden that I must bear.

units.rawText: There's no need to hide it any longer, for I already know it all!
units.displayText: There's no need to hide it any longer, for I already know it all!

spans.text: There's no need to hide it any longer, for I already know it all!

units.rawText: You too have been battling the Organization all this while, haven't you? O comrade of mine?
units.displayText: You too have been battling the Organization all this while, haven't you? O comrade of mine?

spans.text: You too have been battling the Organization all this while, haven't you? O comrade of mine?

units.rawText: ...Er, comrade, why do you look so crestfallen?
units.displayText: ...Er, comrade, why do you look so crestfallen?

spans.text: ...Er, comrade, why do you look so crestfallen?

units.rawText: Miss Makise, and, er, Mr. Okabe, is it?
units.displayText: Miss Makise, and, er, Mr. Okabe, is it?

spans.text: Miss Makise, and, er, Mr. Okabe, is it?

units.rawText: That's right, Professor <cmdr>, but you can call me Kurisu.
units.displayText: That's right, Professor {교수}, but you can call me Kurisu.

spans.text: That's right, Professor
, but you can call me Kurisu.

units.rawText: Hold on, my name is HOUOUIN—
units.displayText: Hold on, my name is HOUOUIN—

spans.text: Hold on, my name is HOUOUIN—

units.rawText: Right, right, I get it. I believe that neither of you means us ill and that you're ordinary people who got caught up in an extraordinary situation. If possible, we in the Oasis would like to provide you with what help we can.
units.displayText: Right, right, I get it. I believe that neither of you means us ill and that you're ordinary people who got caught up in an extraordinary situation. If possible, we in the Oasis would like to provide you with what help we can.

spans.text: Right, right, I get it. I believe that neither of you means us ill and that you're ordinary people who got caught up in an extraordinary situation. If possible, we in the Oasis would like to provide you with what help we can.

units.rawText: Could you tell me about what happened before and after you were brought here?
units.displayText: Could you tell me about what happened before and after you were brought here?

spans.text: Could you tell me about what happened before and after you were brought here?

units.rawText: As I look at Future Gadget No. 099, I recall what happened earlier, before I fell unconscious.
units.displayText: As I look at Future Gadget No. 099, I recall what happened earlier, before I fell unconscious.

spans.text: As I look at Future Gadget No. 099, I recall what happened earlier, before I fell unconscious.

units.rawText: Hehe, since it is the request of a comrade—Then allow me to tell you about how we came to arrive in your world!
